scope: Fifth targeted closure pass over remaining article/form-detail municipalities.

records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal opkoopbescherming page confirms municipality-wide buy-to-let protection for qualifying homes, current 2026 fee EUR 530.90, electronic application route and the statutory exception categories. The current Huisvestingsverordening confirms that the protected WOZ limit is 70% of the NHG cost limit and that stock-change activities such as conversion, formation and splitting are permit regulated. The remaining uncertainty is limited to the exact exception-specific evidence branches presented by the live application form.
closedNonAddressItems: current legal basis for stock-change/splitting permit regime
remaining: exact exception-specific attachment detail from live form where technically exposed

records.closureSearchResult: A municipality-specific Beleidsregel kamerverhuur is officially published for Beesel and applies municipality-wide on its face. It defines kamerverhuur/logies and non-self-contained housing and supplies the policy basis historically used for deviation from the spatial plan. Because the text still references the former Wabo/bestemmingsplan system, it is retained as substantive municipal policy evidence but the exact 2026 procedural translation must be read together with the current Omgevingswet/Omgevingsplan route. The current woningsplitsing product remains separately confirmed.
closedNonAddressItems: existence of a municipality-wide Beesel room-rental policy
remaining: confirm current 2026 legal/procedural effect of the older policy under Omgevingswet
representative address applicability and dynamic application output

records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal splitsingsvergunning product now provides the complete core attachment list. Application can be made with DigiD or by letter. The letter/application must state the building, number of units and reason for splitting. Required attachments are a splitsingsplan compliant with article 106 Book 5 BW and the associated apartments-rights decree, a valuation report for the building(s) and separate dwelling portions, and the granted omgevingsvergunning for splitting. 2026 thresholds are EUR 932.93 rent and EUR 470000 purchase/NHG. This closes the generic form/document residual.
remaining: representative address applicability and any dynamic building/Omgevingsloket additions

records.closureSearchResult: The current Huisvestingsverordening Delft 2023 confirms the statutory splitsingsvergunning matrix in chapter 5. Article 5:1 ties the permit prohibition to the dwelling categories in annex III. Article 5:2 requires the designated application form and explicitly requires applicant/contact data, any representative, street/house number, cadastral location, building year, nature and current use, with further required items continuing in the article/form. This closes the earlier uncertainty over the governing article/form relationship. Current 2026 evaluation/technical-amendment activity confirms the 2023 regulation remains the operative framework rather than old regional regulations.
closedNonAddressItems: article 5:2 designated-form requirement and core applicant/building data
rejection of obsolete historical regional fee/regulation pages as current source
remaining: encode the remaining article-5:2/form fields and annex-III category details if product-level granularity requires them

records.closureSearchResult: The current Huisvestingsverordening Diemen 2026 is now positively confirmed as adopted by the council on 18 June 2026 and effective from 1 July 2026, replacing the 2022 regulation. It confirms: permit duties for withdrawal/conversion/woningvorming and juridical splitting, short-stay prohibition except annex-1 complexes, and opkoopbescherming for four years. For opkoopbescherming the 2026 regulation itself supplies the document matrix: owner name(s), address and recent proof of ownership, plus family-relation proof, a max-12-month temporary-use agreement or evidence of inseparable business premises depending on exception. Decision period is 8 weeks plus max 6-week extension. This resolves the stale-2022-product-page/current-law conflict.
closedNonAddressItems: current permit-duty matrix for stock changes
current opkoopbescherming document matrix and decision period
replacement of 2022 regulation as controlling law
